chapter.name: Daivasura Sampad Vibhaga Yoga
chapter.englishName: Yoga of the Division between Divine and Demoniac Qualities
chapter.description: Krishna explains the divine (daivi) and demoniac (asuri) qualities in human beings. He highlights virtues that lead to liberation and vices that lead to bondage and suffering.
chapter.theme: Understanding divine and demoniac traits and their impact on spiritual progress

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः | दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | abhayaṃ sattva-saṃśuddhir jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ | dānaṃ damaś ca yajñaś ca svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam ||
verses.english_translation: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadfastness in knowledge, charity, self-control, and sincerity are divine qualities.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम् | दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम् ||
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsā satyam akrodhas tyāgaḥ śāntir apaiśunam | dayā bhūteṣv aloluptvaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīr acāpalam ||
verses.english_translation: Non-violence, truthfulness, absence of anger, compassion, and gentleness are divine traits.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता | भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत ||
verses.transliteration: tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ śaucam adroho nātimānitā | bhavanti sampadaṃ daivīm abhijātasya bhārata ||
verses.english_translation: Energy, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, and humility are divine qualities.
verses.meaning: Divine nature includes strength with humility.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च | अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम् ||
verses.transliteration: dambho darpo 'bhimānaś ca krodhaḥ pāruṣyam eva ca | ajñānaṃ cābhijātasya pārtha sampadam āsurīm ||
verses.english_translation: Hypocrisy, arrogance, anger, harshness, and ignorance are demoniac qualities.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता | मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव ||
verses.transliteration: daivī sampad vimokṣāya nibandhāyāsurī matā | mā śucaḥ sampadaṃ daivīm abhijāto 'si pāṇḍava ||
verses.english_translation: Divine qualities lead to liberation; demoniac qualities to bondage.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च | दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे शृणु ||
verses.transliteration: dvau bhūta-sargau loke 'smin daiva āsura eva ca | daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu ||
verses.english_translation: There are two types of beings: divine and demoniac.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः | न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते ||
verses.transliteration: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidur āsurāḥ | na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate ||
verses.english_translation: Demoniac people do not understand right and wrong.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम् | अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम् ||
verses.transliteration: asatyam apratiṣṭhaṃ te jagad āhur anīśvaram | aparaspara-sambhūtaṃ kim anyat kāma-haitukam ||
verses.english_translation: They say the world is without truth or God, driven only by desire.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः | प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः ||
verses.transliteration: etāṃ dṛṣṭim avaṣṭabhya naṣṭātmāno 'lpa-buddhayaḥ | prabhavanty ugra-karmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato 'hitāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Holding such views, they engage in destructive actions.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः | मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः ||
verses.transliteration: kāmam āśritya duṣpūraṃ dambha-māna-madānvitāḥ | mohād gṛhītvāsad-grāhān pravartante 'śuci-vratāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Driven by insatiable desire and pride, they follow impure practices.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः | कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः ||
verses.transliteration: cintām aparimeyāṃ ca pralayāntām upāśritāḥ | kāmopabhoga-paramā etāvad iti niścitāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: They are consumed by endless worries and pleasure-seeking.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः | ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान् ||
verses.transliteration: āśā-pāśa-śatair baddhāḥ kāma-krodha-parāyaṇāḥ | īhante kāma-bhogārtham anyāyenārtha-sañcayān ||
verses.english_translation: Bound by desires and anger, they accumulate wealth unjustly.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम् | इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम् ||
verses.transliteration: idam adya mayā labdham imaṃ prāpsye manoratham | idam astīdam api me bhaviṣyati punar dhanam ||
verses.english_translation: They think: I have gained this today and will gain more tomorrow.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि | ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी ||
verses.transliteration: asau mayā hataḥ śatrur haniṣye cāparān api | īśvaro 'ham ahaṃ bhogī siddho 'haṃ balavān sukhī ||
verses.english_translation: They think: I am powerful, I am the enjoyer, I am successful.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया | यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः ||
verses.transliteration: āḍhyo 'bhijanavān asmi ko 'nyo 'sti sadṛśo mayā | yakṣye dāsyāmi modiṣya ity ajñāna-vimohitāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: They think: I am wealthy and superior; none is equal to me.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः | प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ ||
verses.transliteration: aneka-citta-vibhrāntā moha-jāla-samāvṛtāḥ | prasaktāḥ kāma-bhogeṣu patanti narake 'śucau ||
verses.english_translation: Confused by many thoughts and trapped in delusion, they fall into impure states.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः | यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम् ||
verses.transliteration: ātma-sambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhana-māna-madānvitāḥ | yajante nāma-yajñais te dambhenāvidhi-pūrvakam ||
verses.english_translation: Filled with pride and arrogance, they perform rituals improperly.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः | मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः ||
verses.transliteration: ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ | mām ātma-para-deheṣu pradviṣanto 'bhyasūyakāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Driven by ego, power, desire, and anger, they hate the divine in others.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान् | क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु ||
verses.transliteration: tān ahaṃ dviṣataḥ krūrān saṃsāreṣu narādhamān | kṣipāmy ajasram aśubhān āsurīṣv eva yoniṣu ||
verses.english_translation: Such cruel and hateful people are repeatedly reborn in lower states.
verses.meaning: Negative actions lead to suffering cycles.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: आसुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि | मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम् ||
verses.transliteration: āsurīṃ yonim āpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani | mām aprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yānty adhamāṃ gatim ||
verses.english_translation: Born repeatedly in demoniac conditions, they fail to reach Me.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः | कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत् ||
verses.transliteration: tri-vidhaṃ narakasyedaṃ dvāraṃ nāśanam ātmanaḥ | kāmaḥ krodhas tathā lobhas tasmād etat trayaṃ tyajet ||
verses.english_translation: Three gates to hell are desire, anger, and greed; one must abandon them.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः | आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ||
verses.transliteration: etair vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamo-dvārais tribhir naraḥ | ācaraty ātmanaḥ śreyas tato yāti parāṃ gatim ||
verses.english_translation: Free from these three evils, one attains the highest good.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः | न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम् ||
verses.transliteration: yaḥ śāstra-vidhim utsṛjya vartate kāma-kārataḥ | na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim ||
verses.english_translation: Ignoring scriptural guidance and acting on desire leads to failure.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ | ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि ||
verses.transliteration: tasmāc chāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ te kāryākārya-vyavasthitau | jñātvā śāstra-vidhānoktaṃ karma kartum ihārhasi ||
verses.english_translation: Therefore, follow scriptural guidance to determine right action.
verses.meaning: Wisdom comes from proper knowledge and discipline.
